completed_tasks.name: Provide Swagger payloads for one-record workflow testing
Clarify action notifications versus SLA notifications

remaining_tasks.name: If requested, guide narrow target API hook for immediate action notification dispatch
If requested, guide Task Scheduler setup for run-sla and process-notification-outbox

human_actions_pending.context: User may want either target API code integration for immediate action notifications or Task Scheduler deployment steps for SLA/outbox retry.

decisions.decision: Normal workflow action notifications are API-owned
decisions.rationale: The notification should be sent when a user action moves the record to the next workflow state.

decisions.decision: run-sla is only for overdue detection
decisions.rationale: SLA monitor creates SlaTaskOverdue rows; it does not handle normal transition notifications.

decisions.decision: Task Scheduler should host SLA/outbox processing separately from IIS target API
decisions.rationale: Avoid broad changes to the IIS-hosted target API and keep retry/backlog processing isolated.

next_action: Start by asking whether the user wants one-step-at-a-time target API action-dispatch integration or Task Scheduler setup.
context_notes: Target API should dispatch action-created notification rows immediately after workflow execution succeeds, using WorkflowInstanceId plus CorrelationId. Task Scheduler should run run-sla and process-notification-outbox for overdue detection and retry/backlog.
